baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive plural ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ and the manner/result noun عُرْفًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Release and batchwise movement combine with connected mane-like succession: unspecified plural entities are dispatched as an ordered series whose members remain visibly or temporally linked.

activation_trace.role: Literal sending forth and release supplies the initiating motion of the model.
Successive groups or batches make the plural dispatch serial rather than simultaneous.
Connected succession like mane hairs binds the separate dispatches into one ordered train.

changed_reading.before: An oath by unspecified things that are sent.
changed_reading.after: An oath by releases arriving batch after batch in a connected, ordered succession.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ can activate messenger/message, while عُرْفًا can activate recognition and recognized good.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sent plurality may be carriers, messages, or both; their dispatch makes a marked truth recognizable and conveys something already apprehensible as good. Thus عُرْفًا can color payload or result, not only manner.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and carried message supply the communicative vehicle and payload.
Recognition through a trace or mark supplies the message's disclosure effect.
Recognized good supplies a possible normative quality or content for what is sent.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes dispatched entities without specifying their function.
changed_reading.after: The dispatched plurality can be a communicative delivery that renders a marked good or truth recognizable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ر س ل branches of easy movement, deliberate pace, and willing giving attach to ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ; recognized good attaches to عُرْفًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dispatch can be pictured as controlled rather than strained: it moves smoothly and deliberately and gives willingly, with عُرْفًا marking its beneficent fitness.

activation_trace.role: Smooth, easy movement supplies an unforced mode of going forth.
Gentleness and deliberation make the release measured rather than hurried.
Ease and willing giving make the dispatch potentially provisionary.
Recognized good supplies the positive value assigned to the measured giving.

changed_reading.before: Sending names only an outward movement.
changed_reading.after: The sending may itself be a measured act of beneficent, willing release.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عُرْفًا carries the branch image of a raised visible mane or crest beside the batchwise movement of ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive dispatches can form a perceivable front: not merely one-after-another in time, but serried or cresting in space like the raised line of a mane.

activation_trace.role: Batchwise succession supplies repeated units in the moving formation.
A raised visible crest or mane supplies the formation's spatial silhouette.

changed_reading.before: عُرْفًا is only an abstract adverb of order or goodness.
changed_reading.after: عُرْفًا can also lend the ordered dispatch a raised, visible, crest-like profile.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening release becomes the first phase of a force cascade: dispatch is followed by violent sweeping, then opening and spreading, then discriminating separation. Ordered succession therefore describes controlled sequencing, not necessarily softness.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the cascade's first outward transition.
Connected succession supplies ordered continuity across the phases.
A severe wind that makes things light and scatters them converts release into forceful transport.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the expansion phase after sweeping.
Distinguishing between two things supplies the cascade's separating output.

structural_cues: 77:1-4 repeats feminine plural participial forms followed by manner or cognate accusatives.
The wa-/fa- sequence permits both coordinated oath subjects and successive operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial syntax and release, sweeping, spreading, and separating images; I supply the directional arrow release -> sweep -> spread -> separate. A live alternative is that these are parallel oath subjects rather than causal phases.

changed_reading.before: The dispatch is chiefly smooth, gentle, and serial.
changed_reading.after: The dispatch is controlled and serial, but it initiates an increasingly violent, expansive, and discriminating operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messenger/message becomes a delivery pipeline: a payload is cast, functions as reminder, brings notice to completion, and yields either established excuse or awakened warning. The sent plurality is thus accountable communication, not information in the abstract.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the delivery relation activated by the later payload.
Recognition by a mark supplies the intended cognitive effect of delivery.
Casting until something is laid down supplies concrete deposition of the reminder.
A reminder that makes one remember identifies the deposited payload's function.
Giving full notice and reaching completion supplies the accountability threshold.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the preventive outcome of delivery.

structural_cues: 77:5 places ذِكْرًا as the object of the casting participle.
77:6 immediately supplies the paired outcomes عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting, reminder, completed notice, and warning; I infer that delivery creates an accountability sequence. A live alternative treats excuse and warning as two purposes or message classes rather than successive legal effects.

changed_reading.before: The sent items may carry something recognizable or good.
changed_reading.after: They operate as commissioned deliveries whose deposited reminder establishes notice, excuse, or warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct recurrence of ر س ل as messengers, followed by time-setting, deadline, and adjudicative separation, changes connected succession into a scheduled muster. The opening can anticipate commissioned carriers or their functions being assembled at an appointed limit.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message anchor the focus noun to a communicative commission.
Connected succession supplies the ordered arrival of the commissioned plurality.
The explicit messengers provide a same-root contextual identity candidate for the opening plural.
Fixing something by a time or limit turns succession into appointment.
A prescribed terminal time supplies the deadline toward which the dispatches converge.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the appointed muster's function.

structural_cues: 77:11 repeats the focus root in the explicit noun ٱلرُّسُلُ.
The passive forms in 77:11-12 place messenger appointment and postponement under an external schedule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root messengers, an imposed time, a deadline, and a day of separation; I infer a scheduled muster that the opening anticipates. The live alternative is that 77:11 names different entities and only echoes the oath lexically.

changed_reading.before: The sent plurality is serial but temporally open-ended.
changed_reading.after: Its succession is commissioned toward an imposed deadline at which messengers and their testimony or messages are mustered for separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Batchwise dispatch is mirrored by batchwise reception and consequence: deniers are named, former peoples precede, and later peoples follow them. عُرْفًا can therefore order not only emissaries but the historical cohorts through which one warning pattern is realized.

activation_trace.role: Successive batches supply the focus-side pattern projected onto historical cohorts.
Connected succession keeps earlier and later cohorts in one repeating sequence.
Attributing falsehood identifies the recurrent recipient response that links the cohorts.
Beginning and precedence supply the former cohort's position in the series.
Following in succession supplies the explicit transfer from one cohort to the next.
Later-after-former ordering closes the historical batch relation.

structural_cues: 77:16-18 explicitly moves from former peoples to later peoples and then generalizes the action.
The denier refrain recurs eleven times, repeatedly segmenting the surah into comparable outcome units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies former/later succession and a repeated denier refrain; I infer that the oath's batch image also organizes recipient history. A live alternative is that the refrain only marks rhetorical sections and does not feed back into the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The ordered plurality consists only of whatever is dispatched.
changed_reading.after: The order also encompasses successive recipient cohorts, each receiving and realizing the same dispatch pattern after the former cohort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence repeatedly holds things in bounded places and measures their term before commanding release. Against stable lodging, measured limit, and earth's gathering hold, ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ names the output side of a containment-to-release system; عُرْفًا orders the releases.

activation_trace.role: Release in contrast to holding anchors the output side of the proposed control cycle.
Batchwise succession makes repeated controlled releases possible.
Connected succession supplies the ordering rule across releases.
Fixity and stable settlement supply the held state before release.
A locus of being supplies the bounded place in which the held state persists.
A measure at which something reaches its limit supplies release timing.
Gathering and grasping within a container broadens holding from womb-like lodging to earth.
Freeing from constraint and sending supplies the later command-side reversal into release.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 clusters placement, stable lodging, known measure, earth as container, anchors, and stored water.
77:29-30 repeats the command ٱنطَلِقُوا after the containment sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable holding, bounded place, measure, encompassing earth, and commanded release; I infer a generalized hold -> mature/measure -> release architecture. A live alternative is that the creation and judgment episodes are juxtaposed demonstrations, not a mechanism defining the oath.

changed_reading.before: The sent plurality begins already in motion, with no implied prior state.
changed_reading.after: The plurality may be what is purposefully held to a measure and then released in ordered batches.

context_deltas.mechanism: The obscure flowing-yield and willing-giving branches of ر س ل acquire a material ecology: water is delivered fresh, and true shade and springs shelter the cautious, while an earlier shadow fails to shelter. Ordered sending can therefore be tested by actual provision versus counterfeit provision.

activation_trace.role: Continuous milk or flowing yield supplies a material flow branch for the dispatch.
Ease and willing giving assign the flow a provisionary function.
Recognized good supplies the criterion by which genuine provision is known.
Delivering water by pouring supplies an explicit material transmission.
Causing drink or providing irrigation makes the transmitted water a directed gift.
Fresh sweet water supplies the beneficial quality of the delivered provision.
Shade as covering supplies genuine shelter in contrast to the ineffective shadow of 77:30-31.
A spring as a source of running water extends the provision into sustained flow.

structural_cues: 77:27 joins elevated anchors with giving fresh water.
77:30-31 offers a three-branched shadow that neither shades nor protects, while 77:41 gives real shades and springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flowing yield in the focus inventory and a later polarity of fresh water and effective versus ineffective shelter; I infer that beneficial dispatch can be materially provisionary. A live alternative is that these are destinations of recipients and do not characterize the opening referents.

changed_reading.before: Recognized good is primarily moral or communicative content.
changed_reading.after: Recognized good may also be an ordered, life-supporting flow whose authenticity appears in real water and shelter rather than their destructive counterfeits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The communicative dispatch opens a finite response window. Later, speech is absent, permission to excuse is withheld, a spoken command to bow is refused, and the closing question denies any later discourse as a basis for settled belief. Recognition in عُرْفًا therefore includes the demanded response of acknowledgment before the channel closes.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the communication that opens the response window.
Acknowledgment, confession, or yielding supplies the response potentially solicited by the dispatch.
Literal speech supplies the response capacity explicitly absent on that day.
Excuse or apology supplies the unavailable defensive response.
Permission supplies the gate that is closed against making that apology.
Uttered speech supplies the explicit command within the still-open earthly response scene.
Humility and yielding supply the embodied acknowledgment commanded and refused.
Renewed speech or report supplies the hypothetical later communication denied by the closing question.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response that no later discourse is expected to produce.

structural_cues: The opening delivery sequence reaches reminder, excuse, and warning in 77:5-6.
77:35-36 removes speech and authorized apology; 77:48 stages a refused command; 77:50 closes with a question about any discourse after this one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery at the opening and a later progression from refused response to disabled speech and no subsequent discourse; I infer a finite communication window. A live alternative is that these are separate judgment tableaux without a single channel-opening/channel-closing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sent messages disclose recognizable content without a defined response horizon.
changed_reading.after: They are a time-bounded summons to acknowledge and yield; refusal persists until speech, excuse, and any appeal to a later message are closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses agent and patient instead of identifying the focus noun's referent. It remains anchored in the focus release branch and the later packet branches for release-command and projectile-sending. Render it only as a structural reversal: rejecters of dispatch are themselves commanded onward into a scene that sends projectiles, not as a lexical equation between them and ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sending-forth and release branch of ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ.

activation_trace.role: Sending forth and release establish the agency pattern that the later scene reverses.
Attributing falsehood identifies the recipients whose relation to dispatch is reversed.
Freeing from constraint and sending supplies the command that turns recipients into the sent-onward party.
Sending or throwing an object supplies a second, hostile dispatcher within the destination scene.

changed_reading.before: External messengers or forces are sent toward recipients.
changed_reading.after: The surah can reverse the dispatch relation: those who reject what is sent become themselves sent onward, where another force sends projectiles at them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries an uncommon concrete mane sense of عُرْفًا into distant destructive imagery. It remains anchored in the packet's explicit raised-crest branch and in later branches for a projecting offshoot, flying sparks, and gathered camels. Render it as a visual resonance that darkens the opening silhouette, not as a claim that عُرْفًا lexically means smoke or sparks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The raised visible crest or mane branch of عُرْفًا joined to serial batches in ٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ.

activation_trace.role: Successive batches supply repeated units in the cresting visual formation.
A raised visible mane or crest supplies the concrete silhouette carried into the later imagery.
A branching extremity supplies the plume's divided projecting shape.
Flying fire-sparks supply moving bright units along the destructive crest.
Camels gathered together reinforce a serried animal-profile image without identifying the focus referents.

changed_reading.before: عُرْفًا contributes only abstract order, recognition, or goodness.
changed_reading.after: It can also contribute a raised serried silhouette that the later branching smoke and camel-like sparks replay in a destructive register.

strongest_changes: 77:2-6 turns serial dispatch into a staged force-and-message pipeline ending in accountable reminder and warning.
77:11-13 directly repeats ر س ل and couples messengers to appointment, deadline, and adjudicative separation.
77:20-30 activates a hold-to-measure-to-release architecture that was invisible in the focus-only baseline.
77:35-50 recasts the opening message as a finite opportunity for acknowledgment before speech, excuse, and appeal to any later discourse close.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made distant reversals legible without fixing one referent: release answers containment, message answers silence, recognizable good answers denial, and real provision answers false shelter. The focus roots organize these mechanisms while retaining force, messenger, temporal, material, and visual readings side by side.
remaining_uncertainties: The identity of the feminine plural remains open; the context supports messengers, forces, and operations but does not require their merger.
The opening sequence may be causal phases or coordinated oath subjects; the packet syntax keeps both live.
The provision-flow and mane-to-smoke activations are branch-supported but cross-domain and should remain explicitly exploratory.
